'''LobwuWa Loba''' was an [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and an aspiring [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], when Loba attended the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] as a spectator in the [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]]. Over the next [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]], Loba was able to build a reputation in the [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] world and, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], competed in a race held in the arena.

==Biography==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC">{{Film|I}} is set in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> the [[Ualaq/Legends|Ualaq]] [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]]<ref name="TPM" /> LobwuWa Loba<ref name="Hunted" /> wanted to [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|pilot]] [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]] for a living.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|131|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: An Audience of Aliens}}</ref> Hailing from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="Hunted" /> Loba was present in that [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] to watch the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] from the personal box of the [[Merchant/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]].<ref name="Insider" />

The Aqualish became a relatively established podracer over the next ten [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Loba returned to the Grand Arena as the local favorite to win a [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] competition. Loba was among the competitors that the neophyte [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] recognized as an appreciator of the sport. The winner of the race had been predetermined by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].<ref name="Hunted" />

==Personality and traits==
Loba was thuggish-looking<ref name="Hunted" /> with four [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], brown skin, and light blond [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="TPM" /> The Aqualish had the ability to pilot a podracer and enough determination to make their dream to become a professional racer<ref name="Insider" /> a reality.<ref name="Hunted" />

==Behind the scenes==
LobwuWa Loba appeared on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] in the [[2003]] young reader novel ''[[Boba Fett: Hunted]]'' by [[Elizabeth Hand]].<ref name="Hunted" /> The [[2012]] [[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]] feature in the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine's [[Star Wars Insider 131|131st issue]], "An Audience of Aliens," identified individuals in Watto's viewing box from the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], and [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively established]] that Loba was among them.<ref name="Insider" />
